study type: Secondary analysis of data from a cluster randomised trial
exposure: Hospital variation in quality of care
cohort: 5134 women giving birth by caesarean section in 21 district and regional hospitals in Burkina Faso in a 6-month period in 2016
finding: There is a high burden of intrapartum-related perinatal deaths among caesarean births in Burkina Faso and sub-Saharan Africa more widely, with significant variation in adjusted mortality rates between hospitals, particularly lower volume hospitals, indicating likely differences in quality of caesarean care.
